subject: StratusPay SIG/CAIQ: encryption artifacts for tenant BYOK verification
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stratuspay.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: custsec@stratuspay.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StratusPay CAIQ/SIG follow-up — tenant BYOK / KMS evidence request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG intake and CAIQ review, our security team needs specific artifacts around tenant-byok and the KMS/HSM controls that back encryption-at-rest. We are trying to validate a few items before our internal deadline next Friday. Could you please provide the following or point us to a secure location where we can download them?

1) HSM attestation or vendor statement for the hardware module that protects key material used for customer BYOK.
2) A sample (anonymized) rotation log showing operator actions and key version metadata for one tenant over a 90-day window.
3) Confirmation of envelope encryption: which key hierarchy you use (KEK/DEK) and whether KEK wrapping happens in an HSM.
4) The documented rotation cadence and whether rotation is automatic, manual, or hybrid; any tooling used to drive rotation.
5) Any SOC 2 / SIG mapping rows you maintain that show where these controls are documented (we can accept an exported CAIQ table).

We prefer PDFs for attestations and CSV/Excel for logs. If there's anything sensitive you can't share, a redacted sample or explanation of how we can validate via audit might suffice.

Appreciate a quick reply — our security lead (cc'd) will triage.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Security Engineer, StratusPay

From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stratuspay.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusPay CAIQ/SIG follow-up — tenant BYOK / KMS evidence request

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver all of the items you requested, with a couple notes to keep things concise:

- HSM attestation: we have the FIPS/PCI attestation from our HSM vendor and our own HSM role matrix/attestation. We'll provide the vendor attestation (redacted for serials) as a PDF.

- Rotation log sample: attached is an anonymized CSV representing a 90-day rotation+version history for a single tenant (operator IDs replaced, timestamps preserved). The CSV includes key_id, wrapped_key_version, rotation_trigger, operator_role, and checksum.

- Envelope encryption: Redwood uses a KEK (root wrapping key) stored in the HSM to wrap per-tenant DEKs. The wrapping operation for KEK->DEK happens inside the HSM; DEKs are stored encrypted in object storage. We'll include a short architecture blurb in the CAIQ table.

- Rotation mechanics: rotation is hybrid — automated rotations for DEKs triggered by sequence or age, with manual KEK rotation that requires an approved runbook and multi-operator ceremony. We'll attach our rotation runbook excerpt and a cadence table.

- CAIQ mapping: we'll populate the encryption rows into the CAIQ spreadsheet and include references to our SOC 2 control IDs.

I am attaching three files to get you started: HSM_attestation_2026-09.pdf, kms-rotation-log-sample.csv, caiq-encryption-response-table.xlsx. If anything in those files needs more context (e.g., audit timestamps, HSM vendor contact), loop me in.

One quick question for triage: do you need operator-level unredacted logs for a production tenant, or will the anonymized sample suffice for the CAIQ/SIG review? If the former, we will need a signed NDA and a scheduled window for a read-only audit session.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HSM_attestation_2026-09.pdf (pdf), kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (csv), caiq-encryption-response-table.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stratuspay.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: custsec@stratuspay.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusPay CAIQ/SIG follow-up — tenant BYOK / KMS evidence request

Rachel —

Appreciate the quick turn. The anonymized rotation log and the CAIQ table will likely be fine for our initial SIG review. We may ask for an in-person/VM audit if anything looks ambiguous. A couple clarifying questions after a quick scan of the CSV:

- In the Operator Role column some entries are listed as "crypto_ops" and some as "svc_keymgr" — can you confirm which role(s) are authorized to perform KEK rotations vs DEK rotations?
- The CSV shows rotation_trigger values of "age", "manual", and "rekey-policy" — could you map those to the runbook steps (i.e., which are automatic and which require approval)?

If you can reply with a short mapping table (plain in the email body is fine) that will keep things moving. Also, please confirm whether the KEK's master key material is backed by an HSM attested to FIPS 140-2 or higher.

Thanks,
Alex

From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stratuspay.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusPay CAIQ/SIG follow-up — tenant BYOK / KMS evidence request

Alex —

Answers inline below to keep the record clear.

1) Authorized roles for rotations:
- KEK rotations: authorized_roles = ["infra_security_lead", "crypto_ops"]. KEK rotation requires a two-operator approval (infra_security_lead + crypto_ops), per our runbook section 3.2. Those operator IDs are human operators; all KEK wrap/unwrap operations occur inside the HSM and require smartcard-backed MFA for the operator session.
- DEK rotations: automated by the key manager service under policy; authorized_roles = ["svc_keymgr", "crypto_ops"]. DEK rotation can also be triggered manually by "crypto_ops" in emergency scenarios.

2) Mapping of rotation_trigger values:
- "age" => automated rotation triggered by key age threshold (policy enforced in KMS; no human approval required).
- "manual" => explicit operator-initiated rotation; requires crypto_ops role and an audit comment in the operation log.
- "rekey-policy" => scheduled policy-driven rekey where both DEK and KEK path steps may be involved; for KEK-related rekey workflows, manual approval is required.

3) HSM attestation level:
- Confirmed: KEK master key material is protected by an HSM validated to FIPS 140-2 Level 3 (vendor attestation attached). The PDF includes a vendor statement and our internal HSM role matrix (redacted).

Next steps: we uploaded the files to a secure Drive folder (link below) and added a short readme in the CAIQ spreadsheet explaining the mapping to SIG questions. If you want granular audit evidence (unredacted operator IDs and timestamps) we can schedule a remote read-only session under NDA and a timeboxed log export.

Secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-CAIQ-artifacts
DocuSign acknowledgement (optional): https://www.docusign.net/StratusPay-SIG-ack-98765

If that covers it, happy to close the loop here.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Senior Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (in Drive): HSM_attestation_2026-09.pdf, kms-rotation-log-sample.csv, caiq-encryption-response-table.xlsx
